title: Revel Order History

username.description: Username used to log into Revel.

password.title: Revel Password
password.description: Password used to log into Revel.

store.title: Store
store.description: Revel establishment to extract order history for.

report_date.title: Report Date

end_time.title: End Time
end_time.description: End time for the Order History report in hh:mm AM/PM format.

max_concurrency.title: Maximum Concurrency
